svg.title: Chapter VIII · Embers
svg.desc: Square pixel-art chapter card VIII of VIII, titled VIII · Embers in pixel letters in the night sky. Dawn: the sky turns pale green over the hills. The fire has burnt down to glowing embers, a thin wisp of smoke rises, and a few sparks fly home along dotted trails to the small lit houses on the hills. Pix sits on a stump and watches them go.
